reasoning: Brief identifies as illustration — a hand-drawn game title screen, not photography and not a slide. Style direction 'colorful, simple, hand-drawn, Xiaohei IP' maps to: style.medium: illustration, style.rendering_technique: pencil/hand-drawn line art rendered as 'hand drawn ink line with flat fills', style.aesthetic: [wobbly ink line, flat fills, deadpan absurdist, indie game key art], texture.special: [slightly uneven boiling line, visible hand wobble]. 'Colorful' maps to a locked 7-color palette on warm paper-cream ground rather than the Xiaohei article default of pure white — background #F2EAD3, ink #1E1E1E, coral #E86A5C, sage #8FA582, sunny yellow #F4B942, muted blue #6E8CA0, white #FFFFFF reserved for the character's dot eyes. brand palette treated as locked: every color listed in technical_rules.strict_preserve, no gradients or soft shadows permitted. Subject type determination: the founder is a fictional original IP creature (Xiaohei-descended), not a real person — no block triggered; typed as character with a full canonical description (small solid-black creature, white round dot eyes, thin legs, deadpan expression, slightly irregular hand-drawn outline) plus a consistency_rule so every future asset matches. Core metaphor chosen for the title screen: the literal runway — an airport runway paved with giant dollar bills burning away behind the running founder (burn rate made physical), founder calmly sprinting while carrying a laptop and a potted houseplant (the game's scramble verb and its deadpan comedy in one image). The creature performs the core action, never decorates. exact_text provided: 'RUNWAY!', 'You don't build a startup. You survive one.', 'PRESS ANY KEY' — mapped verbatim character-for-character into text_rendering.elements with hand-lettered treatment; title is part of the drawing, not a typeset overlay. Ambiguity resolved: 16:9 chosen as the game's native screen ratio; documented in usage_context.usage_notes. Operation: text_to_image. No reference images provided. negative_prompt populated with the failure modes of this style: cute kawaii mascot, gradients, 3D render, vector-clean lines, PPT infographic, photorealism. CHARACTER v2 LOCK (user-approved): four ownable marks differentiate our creature from the Xiaohei reference while preserving blank deadpan simplicity — (1) a single wobbly ink cowlick spike on the head, (2) a permanent slight forward lean (perpetually mid-hustle, even at rest), (3) blank white OVAL eyes subtly mismatched with the left a touch bigger (a whisper of sleep deprivation), (4) tiny paper-cream sneakers with ink outlines, one lace permanently untied. The cowlick and lace double as in-game status channels (cowlick droops with burnout, stands tall at milestones).

character.source: The Founder — original IP creature for the game RUNWAY!, descended from the Xiaohei illustration IP
character.description: A small solid ink-black creature with a slightly irregular, hand-wobbled bean-shaped body, leaning hard forward into the sprint — this creature leans slightly forward even at rest, but right now it means it. A single wobbly ink cowlick spike sticks up from the top of its head, blown flat backward by the speed. Two blank white OVAL eyes, subtly mismatched — the left a touch bigger than the right — a whisper of sleep deprivation; expression completely deadpan despite the emergency. No mouth or a single tiny flat line, no eyebrows, no emoji face. Thin stick legs in a full comic mid-air stride, each ending in a tiny paper-cream oval sneaker with an ink outline, one lace whipping loose behind it. Thin stick arms: one pinning an open laptop against its body, the other cradling a small potted houseplant. No clothing beyond the sneakers. It is earnest and calm, like a low-key employee evacuating according to procedure.
character.consistency_rule: match this creature design exactly in all future RUNWAY! assets — solid ink-black body, blank white oval eyes with the left slightly bigger, ONE cowlick spike on the head, permanent slight forward lean, thin stick limbs, tiny paper-cream sneakers with one untied lace, deadpan expression, wobbly hand-drawn outline; characters are differentiated only by carried props and one accessory, never by body shape or facial expression; the cowlick is a status channel (droops with burnout, stands tall at milestones)

palette locked to exactly: #F2EAD3, #1E1E1E, #E86A5C, #F4B942, #8FA582, #6E8CA0, #FFFFFF — no additional colors

usage_context.purpose: title screen key art for the game RUNWAY! and the master style-lock test image — every visual decision here becomes law for 600+ future assets
usage_context.usage_notes: Inferences made: 16:9 chosen as the game's native screen ratio since the brief did not specify. The burning-money runway metaphor was invented for this image — it fuses the game's title, its core resource (cash runway), and its scramble verb (grab and run) into one readable scene. Paper cream replaces the Xiaohei article-standard pure white deliberately: this is game key art, not an article illustration, and cream is the game's locked background identity. If this image approves, the character consistency_rule and the 7-color palette become the style constitution for all future prompts.
